note: Each threshold the template's rules hold to, with the sites it was measured on (from the code's own comments; [] where none is recorded). scripts/test/thresholds.test.mjs checks every value against the code. A threshold measured on fewer than two sites is listed in each site's layout plan (layout-plan.md) for review on a new site.
